Xuanzang's Places

Every country and site of the Da Tang Xiyu ji (大唐西域記), placed where this study now puts it. The study starts from Mizutani Shinjō's identifications (1971) and tests them against Julien, Vivien de Saint-Martin, Cunningham, Majumdar, Beal, Watters and Dey; the Archaeological Survey's reports, Annual Reports and Indian Archaeology – A Review; Epigraphia Indica and the CII; the British Indian gazetteers; the Life; and route tests on Xuanzang's distances and bearings. Colour shows the study's confidence, taken from the notes' assessments: secure, probable, open, or untested where the study has not assessed Mizutani's view. A dark ring marks a place where the study revises or strengthens Mizutani; the "Mizutani's points" layer shows his sites where they differ.
